model_output:
```sql
WITH fc_regions AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Fairfax County' AND border_type ILIKE 'county'
),
universities_in_fc AS (
  SELECT pois.id
  FROM pois
  JOIN fc_regions ON ST_Contains(fc_regions.geometry::geometry, pois.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.amenity = 'university'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_universities_above_500m
FROM universities_in_fc u
JOIN pois p ON u.id = p.id
WHERE ST_Value(
  (SELECT rast FROM public.dem_us WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, p.geometry::geometry)),
  p.geometry::geometry
) > 500;
```
